notes: 0D fallback mission integrator (SUAVE not importable in this container -- see _probe_suave_available).
Cruise segment reuses analyses.mission.operational_envelope's exact Th2/drag pipeline (Night-3 / P1-C grid point at Mach 2.5 / 6000 m ISA).

cruise_duration_s=60.0 s is a SZACOWANY fixed placeholder: vehicles/ramjet_rocket/vehicle_config.yaml stage_2 has no fuel_mass_kg field, so cruise duration cannot be derived from a real fuel budget yet.
CD0=0.35 zero-lift drag coefficient is SZACOWANY (no CFD drag polar across the Mach/altitude grid yet; single CFD reference point only, see operational_envelope module docstring).
Boost segment thrust/drag: impulse-consistent sea-level thrust (Isp_sl*mdot*g0) and the booster's own step-CD(Mach)+fin-CD drag model, both evaluated at the burnout_state.json handoff state.
Staging event (booster separation -> ramjet ignition) is NOT modeled as a third segment here (out of this baseline's scope; see workflows.ramp_staged_mission for the staging-event placeholder).
